item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 6 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 6 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 17 August 2026(Monday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Zambales, Bataan, Metro Manila(Caloocan, Malabon, Valenzuela, Marikina, Navotas, Quezon City), Bulacan(Meycauayan, Obando, Bulakan, Malolos, Hagonoy, Paombong), Rizal(Antipolo, Rodriguez, San Mateo, Cainta, Taytay) and Pampanga(Floridablanca, Lubao, Sasmuan, Macabebe, Masantol, Porac, Angeles).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Rizal(Angono, Baras, Binangonan, Cardona, Morong, Teresa, Tanay, Pililla, Jala-Jala), Bulacan(Norzagaray, San Jose del Monte, Baliuag, Bustos, Pandi, Angat, Santa Maria, Marilao, Bocaue, Balagtas, Guiguinto, Plaridel, Pulilan, Calumpit), Pampanga(Apalit, Minalin, Guagua, Santa Rita, San Fernando, Bacolor, Santo Tomas, Mabalacat, Mexico, San Luis, San Simon, Santa Ana), Tarlac(Camiling, San Clemente, Mayantoc, Santa Ignacia, San Jose, Capas, Bamban), Cavite(Ternate, Maragondon, Magallanes, Dasmarinas, General Emilio Aguinaldo, Gen. Mariano Alvarez, Trece Martires, Naic, General Trias, Rosario, Tanza, Carmona, Noveleta, Cavite City, Kawit, Imus, Bacoor, Indang), Batangas(Nasugbu), Laguna(San Pedro), Quezon(General Nakar) and Metro Manila(Las Pinas, Muntinlupa, Paranaque, Pasay, Taguig, Pateros, Makati, Mandaluyong, Pasig, San Juan, Manila).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.


Meanwhile, light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Tarlac(Concepcion, Anao, Tarlac City, Gerona, La Paz, Paniqui, Pura, Ramos, San Manuel, Victoria, Moncada), Pampanga(Arayat, Candaba, Magalang), Bulacan(San Miguel, San Ildefonso, Dona Remedios Trinidad, San Rafael), Quezon(Infanta, Real, San Francisco, San Andres, San Narciso, Mulanay, Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, Tayabas, Lucban, Lucena, Mauban, Pagbilao, Sampaloc), Batangas(Agoncillo, Alitagtag, Balete, Bauan, Calaca, Tanauan, Cuenca, Laurel, Lemery, Lipa, Mabini, Malvar, Mataasnakahoy, San Jose, San Luis, San Nicolas, San Pascual, Santa Teresita, Santo Tomas, Taal, Talisay, Tingloy, Batangas City, Ibaan, Lobo, Padre Garcia, Rosario, San Juan, Taysan, Balayan, Calatagan, Lian, Tuy), Laguna(Alaminos, Bay, Cabuyao, Calauan, Calamba, Santa Rosa, Liliw, Los Banos, Luisiana, Magdalena, Majayjay, Nagcarlan, Pagsanjan, Pila, Rizal, San Pablo, Santa Cruz, Victoria, Binan, Cavinti, Famy, Kalayaan, Lumban, Mabitac, Paete, Pakil, Pangil, Santa Maria, Siniloan) and Cavite(Tagaytay, Alfonso, Mendez, Amadeo, Silang) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
